verdict.rationale: Relay's docs confirm the core capability: issuing cards, setting spend limits, defining roles, and real-time transaction tracking, plus limit-management UI in Accounts→Limits. However, evidence lacks detail on truly granular per-employee controls (e.g., category restrictions, time-based limits) and one review notes minor issues with 'prescribed limits' in practice. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of granular per-employee permission types beyond roles, and independent verification that limit controls work reliably at scale.
